name: TAF Inpatient Outcomes
description: Processed inpatient outcomes dataset derived from the TAF Inpatient Claims files. Contains beneficiary-level hospitalization events with admission and discharge information, diagnosis codes, and associated payment data for Medicaid enrollees. Note: not all states are available in TAF data from 2014-2015, as this was a transition period between MAX and TAF. From 2016-2018, all states are available.

license.name: No license, user must be under Data User Agreement (DUA)

name: TAF Inpatient Outcomes File
description: Processed, beneficiary-level inpatient outcomes derived from the TAF Inpatient Claims. Each record represents a single hospitalization event for a Medicaid enrollee, including admission and discharge details, primary and secondary diagnoses, and payment information.

content.bene_id: String: BENE_ID. Unique beneficiary identifier. In the TAF/CCW context, this corresponds to the encrypted CCW beneficiary identifier used to uniquely identify an individual across CCW files.
content.clm_id: String: CLM_ID. Unique claim identifier. In the TAF/CCW claims codebook, CLM_ID is the CCW claim identifier used to link header, line, and related claim records.
content.outcome: String: OUTCOME. Outcome short name. This is a label for the outcome definition being applied.
content.outcome_criteria: String: OUTCOME_CRITERIA. Rule used to evaluate diagnosis codes for admissions. According to the provided schema, 'all' considers all available diagnosis codes for the admission, while 'first_n' considers only a specified number of diagnosis codes, such as the first 5.
content.year: Int64: YEAR. Year of the record.
